text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: Good work today... Wait, huh, this smell is...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― I'm sorry...
Was the smell――too strong, perhaps?
choice_data_list: No, not at all. Smells great.
No, not at all. It smells great.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... Actually, I made
some potpourri out of lavender—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"The scent of lavender has
properties that alleviate headaches, so—"
choice_data_list: Huh, you have a headache!? Are you okay?
Huh, you have a headache!? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm fine—
I took my medicine, and thanks to
the aroma, it's gotten much—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, it seems...
I'm not quite at my best—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Curren Bouquetd'or suffer from
a headache filled me with pure worry.
